description: Designed and built outdoor spaces using bricks, tile, and natural stone, creating both simple and high-end landscapes tailored to each client's vision. Also performed general repairs, installations, and maintenance for residential and light commercial properties.
Started tile installation at the age of 22 and have completed floor and wall tile installations for both residential and commercial projects, with a strong focus on quality and precision.
Full kitchen and bath remodels, flooring, drywall, and repairs for residential clients. Managed every job end to end, quoting, sourcing, build, and finish.
